generation_boundary.commit_rule: NarrativeEventBundle proposes intent; WorldStateDelta commits selected changes in serial order.

pipeline_summary: RunWorldState, BattleResult, SessionContext are reduced to a stage brief.
The stage brief produces one NarrativeEventBundle with world_line, player_line, and shared nodes.
Gameplay Purpose Gate rejects nodes without gameplay_purpose, gameplay_hooks, or proposed_delta_summary.
Commit Gate accepts only reviewed WorldStateDelta operations and never rewrites the base worldbook.
Review pack links each stage to NPC, materials, map nodes, battle nodes, research hooks, and reusable assets.

commit_gate_checks: Reject player-visible text that exposes technical or tool terms.
Reject direct base worldbook mutation; accept only reviewed WorldStateDelta operations.
Reject unregistered NPCs, materials, map nodes, or enemies unless marked candidate-only.
Reject first-battle violations of one field trial and mid-battle sample delivery.
Reject overpowered effects with no cost, phase limit, placement rule, or instance limit.
Reject scouting assets that reveal hidden regions without action cost or confidence limits.
Reject content that is only atmosphere and has no gameplay_purpose, gameplay_hooks, or proposed_delta_summary.
